result.topic_en: The page gives a quaternion-like linear substitution under which the four-variable Laplace operator is multiplied by a constant factor, notes a finiteness claim for invariants of subgroups of the projective group, and then turns to remarks on formulas versus thinking and on methods versus results in mathematics.
